Eleven copper. Today's takings.

She was there again, at the edge of the market. Hood pulled low, standing in front of the shelf that never sells, leaving without buying anything. Third time, or fourth. Our customer relations department has stopped counting. The customer relations department is also me.

I almost said, "If you're not buying, at least say something." I didn't. I had the feeling she would stop coming.

I rewrote the tag on the necklace again today. Thirty copper became forty.
